claims.evidence: Visual inspection of the engine exterior cannot confirm its import origin or 'Tokunbo' status.
A verbal or written guarantee is a contractual promise that cannot be verified through photos of the hardware.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical failure or low compression
risks.proof: A video clip showing a compression test being performed on all cylinders.
risks.if_unproven: as a non-running core for parts only

risks.risk: Internal sludge or poor maintenance history
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine with the oil filler cap removed, showing the condition of the valvetrain.
risks.if_unproven: as a high-mileage unit requiring a rebuild

risks.risk: Faulty or missing sensors and wiring harness damage
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all sensor plugs and the full length of the wiring harness.
risks.if_unproven: as an incomplete unit with electrical faults

proof_requests: Photo of the engine under the oil filler cap
Clear photos of all electrical connectors and sensors
Documentation or shipping labels proving Japanese origin
response.reason: The engine has been clearly identified as a Toyota 1TR by the witness, allowing for a baseline valuation at its worst-case functional state.
